title: [P2] Deliver the existing W3 compiled candidate and authoritative controlled graph receipts

labels.name: P2
labels.description: Provenance/observability, or a claim stated beyond its evidence

body:
Continue Tessera #1381/#702; do not create another graph campaign. Deliver the exact compiled candidate, digest-bound measurement manifest, schema/version, raw evidence and supported producer replay interface. Preserve current source/native-build, image, artifact, compiler/configuration, context, capacity, mode/regime, TP and fabric custody. Run the existing matched eager/graph protocol for the claimed scope; retain actual capture and replay observations and explicit limits. A four-layer stub, shortened-context pass, old-image pass or graphs-enabled generation alone cannot establish current full-model TP2 qualification; W7 owns that full-model leg.

The authoritative interface already exists: tessera.graph_receipt.verify(receipt, serve), using tessera.graph_equals_eager.v2. It rederives equality and replay, requires independent eager/graph populations with the two complete 48-choice passes, and exactly matches serve scope including fabric. V1 cannot attest publication. Deliver this interface and genuine controlled receipts to the existing PrismaQuant W4 consumer rather than copying equality arithmetic or inventing a parallel verifier. No compiled cells are present in inspected contract v67; its graph-gap references are not positive receipts. Bind native-build and complete artifact identity outside the graph schema where its existing fields do not cover them. Candidate access must not depend on W10 publication. Coordinate affected-source invalidation with W5 and preserve compatibility with current PrismaQuant main.
